Body.Content: Building on Azure Automation's support for native PowerShell as another runbook type, hybrid runbook workers now support native PowerShell runbooks, enabling you to automate IT management on-premises by using pure PowerShell. To use this feature, click Start in any PowerShell script runbook, and select the hybrid worker group for it to run on. For more information, see Announcing Native PowerShell Script Support in Azure Automation.
Body.Markdown:
Building on Azure Automation's support for native PowerShell as another runbook type, hybrid runbook workers now support native PowerShell runbooks, enabling you to automate IT management on-premises by using pure PowerShell. To use this feature, click Start in any PowerShell script runbook, and select the hybrid worker group for it to run on.

For more information, see Announcing Native PowerShell Script Support in Azure Automation .
